objective: Repair truncated/clipped prose and excessive blank space in released Kabihasnang Ligaw Chapter 2 on Android, match admin manuscript paragraph breaks, and prevent scrolled reading under the system status bar.
productionBaselineEvidence:
verified: GitHub main 0be759bd27d4771bac2b40b4939cb2a115ef7d3a was inspected, including KlReaderScreen, KlAdminPreview, manuscript splitter and Android shell. Read-only production Supabase project yhanxndaqbmuzbdqlblu showed S1 Chapter 2 has 6 whitespace-only blank lines; example 'Hindi sabay...' is 324 characters combined by released /
{2,}/ splitter while the admin uses /
\s*
/. The user-supplied November 7 Android screenshot shows a one-line ellipsis, a giant blank text area and scroll into the system status bar. Media server verification shows 14/14 approved scenes still map to unique paragraphs after corrected splitting. Live device build SHA is not verified.
chosenApproach: Unify blank-line normalization across canonical released reader, dynamic reader and admin preview using one pure splitter that treats whitespace-only blank lines as borders. Render standard Android story prose as a direct Text child (retaining interactive nested Text only when glossary references occur). Keep native scroll viewport outside the status bar rather than only adding scrollable content top padding; preserve all manuscript content and chapter media/point APIs.
selectionRationale: The editor/reader discrepancy is an actual, reproducible source bug in Chapter 2. The large joined text block and nested Text spans create Android clipping risk. A pure text-only presentation correction avoids any manuscript overwrite, schema change or reward invalidation.
alternativeApproaches: Rewrite approved Chapter 2 manuscript to remove whitespace blank lines: rejected, would mutate released canon and readers/rewards.
Force fixed-height truncated paragraphs with Read More: rejected, loses story content and creates giant blank gaps.
Rewrite all native reader layout and new pagination: rejected, scope/risk disproportional.
Remove dictionary interactivity from all paragraphs: rejected, preserve glossary taps only where terms exist.
preserveBehaviors: Full published manuscript remains untouched and unreleased content stays gated
All 14 approved illustration anchors and effects remain readable without remapping, reapproval, or reupload
Chapter completion points, bookmarks, discussion, music, and release/admin permissions unchanged
Glossary terms still open their descriptions; direct prose has no artificial ellipsis or length cap
Web and iOS viewport safe areas remain unchanged; Android top inset is static above scrolled content
No Android production OTA until staged native verification and runtime compatibility
acceptanceChecks: The Chapter 2 example with space-only blank line splits into distinct paragraphs and preserves every word
Canonical reader, private admin preview and dynamic reader share the same paragraph parser
Single newline inside an intentional paragraph is preserved; BOM/CRLF/tabs handled
Prose without glossary terms is a direct Text child; no body numberOfLines or ellipsizeMode
Android scroll cannot pass under native status bar while mobile bottom nav remains unaffected
Build/QA regressions succeed; 14/14 approved scene anchors remain valid
